title: 第10章 释放，雷印
slug: 全职法师全本免费-全职法师最新章节列表
content_zh:
莫凡沉静下来，全神贯注的开始再一次尝试7颗星子同时把控！
第一颗星子最为听话，毕竟也是每天爱抚出来的，莫凡一声令下这颗活泼的星子马上就停止的活动，滞留在了星尘的最中亚位置。
第二颗星子显得几分小倔强，很不情愿的马上尾随过去，与第一颗星子排列在一起。
紧随其后，第三课，第四颗，第五颗……
第六颗非常听话，屁颠屁颠的就跑到队列上了。
哟西，就差最后一颗了！
莫凡意念高度集中，所有的精神力都集中在第七颗星子那里。
第七颗星子在星尘内高速的飞驰着，听到莫凡的意念呼唤后慢慢的停了下来，带着几分不耐烦，带着几分不快的慢慢的归入到星轨之中……
GOD-BOY，GOD-BOY！！
莫凡看到第七颗星子有要收服的趋势，顿时小激动了起来。
假如前六颗星子是汪星人，一喊他们就乖乖的坐在那里一动不动的话，那么这第七颗星子就是喵星人，尼玛浑身上下都透出了猫的那份高冷和不耐烦……
既然你要我静止，我就勉为其难的配合一下。
缓慢的，缓慢的……
第七颗星子终于静止了下来，与其他六颗星子排列在一起。
刹那间，绚丽唯美的星尘之内多出了一条惊艳迷人的星轨，这道星轨呈现出了雷霆的紫色星能，以第一颗星子为媒介宛如流星拖出了长长的紫色瑰丽尾巴，顺着其他六颗星子飞逝而过！！
星轨成！
魔法现！
坐在公交巴士最后端，穿着黑色衬衣的莫凡身体周围忽然缭绕出了一道曲线的轨迹，紫色的星尘轨迹一闪而过，带给莫凡浑身一种说不出的力量。
“雷印！！！”
“是雷印！！！”

莫凡心中狂喜，忍不住要仰天大笑！
“滋滋滋~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~”
右手上，宛如一条蟒蛇在手臂上缠绕，紫色的雷印之力就蓄在莫凡的手上，只要莫凡手一挥出，必定化为一道雷电狂印飞向巴士中央！
“我的天啊！！”
“魔法师，是魔法师！！”
“还是雷系魔法师……啊，我怎么感觉浑身发麻。”
巴士内传出了一片惊呼之声，刚买完菜的老大妈，做完运动回家的老头，低头玩手机的少女，以及正在用一只手猥亵手机少女的色狼全部惊愕无比的看着最后座的莫凡。
“大……大法师，我……我下次不敢了，我下次不敢了，求您放过我，我有眼不识泰山……”忽然，那个猥亵少女的中年瘦男吓得跪倒在地上，一把眼泪一把鼻涕的向莫凡求饶。
中年色狼以为这位年轻的魔法师是看到了自己猥琐的行为才动怒开启雷霆之力。
这雷霆之力相当可怕，整个车厢的人身体都被那股雷之力震慑的浑身发麻，尤其是那个猥亵少女的色狼，他的手都麻痹的快没知觉了！
“饶你一条狗命，下次再让我看见你，直接把你手废了！”莫凡豁然站了起来，气势凛然的俯视着那个色狼道。
“是，是，下次绝对不敢，下次绝对不敢。”说完，色狼已经乘着司机停下车来的时候连滚带爬的逃出了车子。
周围大妈、大爷们马上报以赞许，几个显然还只是初中生的少年更是向莫凡投来了崇拜的目光。
“妈妈，哥哥好厉害啊，我以后也能够像他这么厉害吗？”一个七八岁的小孩童拽着妈妈的裙子，弱弱的问道。
“魔法师不是什么人都可以做到的，尤其是雷系的法师。”
莫凡发现自己的魔法已经引起了整车的骚动，为了避免被找麻烦，莫凡匆匆忙忙的下车去了。
到了路边，莫凡心情仍旧没有平静下来。
我了个草，太尼玛帅了！！！
回想起刚才手臂缠绕雷之印，随手一挥就可以灭掉一个人的恐怖感觉，前所未有，宛如梦境啊！！！
这就是魔法？？

这就是魔法！！！！
莫凡心脏噗咚噗咚的跳动着，哪怕刚才那个雷印其实并没有释放出去，但莫凡已经感觉到雷霆之力的威力，它们从自己身体内涌出，它们可以随意让自己掌控，它们可以给自己带来从来没有想过的力量。
全车人投来的那份尊敬，跪在地上吓尿求饶的那个色狼，还有手臂上缠绕着雷力的神奇……
这真的是前所未有的畅快和不可思议！！
“哈哈哈哈，雷印我已经学会了，只用了一个学期的时间，现在看你们谁还能挡我？？什么慕白，什么照庭，都得给老子跪舔！”

content_en:
Mo Fan calmed down and concentrated on trying to control 7 stars at the same time again!
The first star was the most obedient. After all, it was caressed every day. This lively star stopped immediately after Mo Fan gave an order and stayed in the most central position of the star dust.
The second star seemed a little stubborn, and reluctantly followed it immediately, aligning with the first star.
Following closely, the third lesson, the fourth, the fifth...
The sixth one was very obedient and ran to the queue like crazy.
Yoxi, just the last one is missing!
Mo Fan was highly concentrated and all his mental power was concentrated on the seventh star.
The seventh star was flying at high speed in the star dust. After hearing Mo Fan's call, it slowly stopped. With a bit of impatience and a bit of displeasure, it slowly returned to the star orbit...
GOD-BOY, GOD-BOY! !
Mo Fan saw that the seventh star was trying to conquer, and he suddenly became excited.
If the first six stars are dogs, and they will sit there obediently and motionless when called, then this seventh star is a cat, and the coldness and impatience of a cat are all over his body...
Since you want me to stay still, I will reluctantly cooperate.
Slowly, slowly...
The seventh star finally stopped and lined up with the other six stars.
In an instant, a stunning and charming star track appeared in the gorgeous stardust. This star track showed the purple star energy of thunder. Using the first star as a medium, it was like a meteor dragging out a long purple tail, flying past the other six stars! !
The star track is complete!
Magic appears!
Sitting at the end of the bus, Mo Fan, who was wearing a black shirt, suddenly had a curved trajectory around his body. The purple stardust trajectory flashed past, giving Mo Fan an indescribable power.
"Thunder Seal!!!"
"It's the thunder seal!!!"
Mo Fan was so happy that he couldn't help but look up to the sky and laugh!
“Zizzizi~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~”
On his right hand, it was like a python wrapping around his arm. The power of the purple thunder seal was stored in Mo Fan's hand. As soon as Mo Fan waved his hand, it would turn into a thunder and lightning seal and fly towards the center of the bus!
“Oh my God!!”
"Magician, it's a magician!!"
"Still a lightning magician...ah, why do I feel numb all over."
There was a sound of exclamation in the bus. The old lady who had just bought groceries, the old man who came home from exercising, the girl who was playing with her mobile phone with her head down, and the pervert who was using one hand to molest the girl on the mobile phone all looked at Mo Fan in the last seat in amazement.
"Great... Archmage, I... I won't dare next time, I won't dare next time, please let me go, I can't see the mountain..." Suddenly, the middle-aged thin man who molested the girl was so frightened that he knelt down on the ground and begged Mo Fan for mercy with tears and snot in his nose.
The middle-aged pervert thought that the young magician got angry and activated the power of thunder after seeing his obscene behavior.
The power of this thunder was quite terrifying. The entire body of the people in the carriage was shaken by the power of thunder, and their bodies were all numb, especially the pervert who molested the girl. His hands were so numb that he almost lost consciousness!
"Spare your life. Next time I see you, I will kill your hands!" Mo Fan suddenly stood up and looked down at the pervert with awe.
"Yes, yes, I will never dare to do it next time, I will never dare to do it next time." After saying that, the pervert had already rolled out of the car when the driver stopped the car.
The aunts and uncles around him immediately responded with praise, and a few teenagers who were obviously only junior high school students cast admiring glances at Mo Fan.
"Mom, my brother is so powerful. Can I be as powerful as him in the future?" A seven or eight-year-old child asked weakly, pulling on his mother's skirt."Not everyone can be a magician, especially a lightning magician."
Mo Fan found that his magic had caused a commotion in the entire car. In order to avoid getting into trouble, Mo Fan hurriedly got out of the car.
When they reached the roadside, Mo Fan's mood still hadn't calmed down.
I'm confused, he's so handsome! ! !
Recalling the terrifying feeling of having the thunder seal wrapped around my arm just now, and being able to kill a person with just a wave of my hand, it was unprecedented, like a dream! ! !
Is this magic? ?
This is magic! ! ! !
Mo Fan's heart was beating loudly. Even though the thunder seal had not been released, Mo Fan had already felt the power of the thunder. They surged out from his body. They could be controlled by him at will, and they could bring him power that he had never thought of.
The respect shown by everyone in the car, the pervert who knelt on the ground and begged for mercy, and the magic of thunder wrapped around his arm...
This is truly unprecedented and incredible! !
"Hahahaha, I have already learned the thunder seal. It only took one semester. Now, who of you can stop me?? Mubai and Zhaoting have to kneel down and lick them!"
